description: 车将军兼捉车——将军并攻击另一个子
explanation_en: A checking fork by a rook.

intro.popup: 💡 捉双：白车在h7，如何将军同时威胁黑车？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Fork: White's rook is on h7. How can it give check and threaten the black rook at the same time?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rh6+将军！黑王被迫应将，白车随即吃掉c6车。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rh6+ checks the king. After the forced king move, White captures the rook on c6.

moves.popup: 车到h6将军！同时沿第6横线威胁c6车——捉双！
moves.popup_en: The rook checks from h6 while attacking the rook on c6 along the sixth rank. A checking fork!

moves.popup: 黑王被迫离开，c6车无人保护。
moves.popup_en: The king is forced to move, leaving the rook on c6 undefended.
The rook captures on c6, and White wins material!
